add_position_actuator: add a scaled position actuator to a PyMJCF joint, tendon, or site with a given position range and control range
add_velocity_actuator: add a scaled velocity actuator to a PyMJCF joint, tendon, or site with a given velocity range and control range
check_target_and_kwargs: validate that a PyMJCF target element and keyword arguments are allowed before creating an actuator
review_add_position_actuator: review the add_position_actuator function to understand how it computes affine gain and bias parameters for position control
review_add_velocity_actuator: review the add_velocity_actuator function to understand how it computes affine gain and bias parameters for velocity control
